answer: Proof of Stake serves as a kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies by tethering identity to capital commitment. Since creating a new identity costs as much as the copper required for hardware or the native tokens staked, an attacker faces a prohibitive financial barrier at the dawn of any attempt to flood the network. This economic weight forces adversaries to expend significant resources to exert influence, effectively ensuring that authority scales with honest investment rather than malicious proliferation.
